keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Genoa 0, AC Milan 1. Alphadjo Cisse (AC Milan) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Adrien Rabiot.
Goal! Genoa 0, AC Milan 2. Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Gonçalo Ramos.
Sankhoun Diawara (AC Milan) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second Half begins Genoa 0, AC Milan 2.
Alessandro Marcandalli (Genoa) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Adrien Rabiot (AC Milan) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, AC Milan. Omari Hutchinson replaces Alphadjo Cisse.
Substitution, AC Milan. Filippo Terracciano replaces Sankhoun Diawara.
Substitution, Genoa. Tommaso Baldanzi replaces Junior Messias.
Substitution, Genoa. Stephan El Shaarawy replaces Alessandro Marcandalli.
Substitution, Genoa. Lorenzo Colombo replaces Vítinha.
Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, AC Milan. Ardon Jashari replaces Christian Pulisic.
Substitution, Genoa. Djibril Sow replaces Hamed Traoré.
Substitution, Genoa. Ethan Meichtry replaces Samuel Wiafe.
Mario Gila (AC Milan) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, AC Milan. Pervis Estupiñán replaces Yunus Musah.
Goal! Genoa 1, AC Milan 2. Mikael Ellertsson (Genoa) left footed shot from outside the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Tommaso Baldanzi following a set piece situation.
Kingsley Ehizibue (Genoa) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
